Nome do parâmetro na Remote API do Voice: Parameter name in the Voicemeeter Remote API.
Voicemeeter is not installed on this PC.
Liga, desliga, brilho e temperatura de c: On, off, brightness and color temperature of Elgato lights (Key Light, Light Strip) over the local network.
Aparece no Elgato Control Center, nas co: Shown in Elgato Control Center, in the light's settings. Different port: 192.168.0.50:9123.
Luzes, salas e cenas do Philips Hue pelo: Philips Hue lights, rooms and scenes through the Hue Bridge on your network, no cloud account.
Nenhum Hue Bridge encontrado. Digite o I: No Hue Bridge found. Type its IP (shown in the Hue app, under Settings → Bridges).
Aperte o botão redondo do Hue Bridge e t: Press the round button on the Hue Bridge and tap Pair again (within 30 seconds).
The Hue Bridge refused the pairing.
O Hue Bridge recusou o acesso. Pareie de: The Hue Bridge refused access. Pair again.
Couldn't reach the Hue Bridge. Check the IP.
Lâmpadas e fitas Govee pela rede local (: Govee bulbs and strips over the local network (needs LAN Control enabled in the Govee Home app).
Procura na rede ao abrir. Se não aparece: Searches the network when opened. If it doesn't show up, type the device IP.
O aparelho Govee não respondeu. Confira: The Govee device didn't respond. Check the IP and LAN Control in the Govee Home app.
A porta UDP 4002 está em uso por outro p: UDP port 4002 is in use by another program (it's needed to talk to Govee).
Publica uma mensagem num tópico do seu b: Publishes a message to a topic on your MQTT broker (Mosquitto, Home Assistant, Node-RED, Zigbee2MQTT...).
Text or JSON. Can be empty.
O broker guarda a última mensagem do tóp: The broker keeps the topic's last message for whoever subscribes later.
O broker MQTT recusou o usuário ou a sen: The MQTT broker rejected the username or password.
Não foi possível conectar ao broker MQTT: Couldn't connect to the MQTT broker. Check the address.
The MQTT broker refused the message.
Dispara uma ação do Streamer.bot (com ar: Runs a Streamer.bot action (with arguments) through its WebSocket Server.
Also accepts a typed action name.
Um por linha (chave=valor) ou um objeto: One per line (key=value) or a JSON object. They become %key% in Streamer.bot.
Não foi possível conectar ao Streamer.bo: Couldn't connect to Streamer.bot. Turn on its WebSocket Server (Servers/Clients).
O Streamer.bot pede senha. Preencha a se: Streamer.bot asks for a password. Fill in the WebSocket Server password.
Dispara atalhos (expressões, animações): Triggers the model's hotkeys (expressions, animations) in VTube Studio or switches models.
Atalhos do modelo carregado agora. També: Hotkeys of the currently loaded model. Also accepts a typed name.
Permita o DroidDeck na janela que abriu: Allow DroidDeck in the window that opened in VTube Studio.
Não foi possível conectar ao VTube Studi: Couldn't connect to VTube Studio. Turn on the API in Settings → Start API.
O VTube Studio negou o acesso. Toque em: VTube Studio denied access. Tap Connect to ask again.
Ninguém respondeu no VTube Studio. Toque: Nobody answered in VTube Studio. Tap Connect to ask again.
O VTube Studio recusou o token. Toque em: VTube Studio rejected the token. Tap Connect to ask again.
Segurar enquanto o dedo estiver no botão: Hold while your finger is on the button
Travar: um toque aperta, outro solta: Latch: one tap presses, the next releases
Aperta uma tecla no PC: segura enquanto: Presses a key on the PC: holds it while your finger is on the button, taps it, or keeps it latched until the next tap.
Escolha na lista ou digite outra: A-Z, 0: Pick from the list or type another: A-Z, 0-9, F13-F24, NUMPAD0 or the code (0x41).
O botão não está mais no PC. Atualize o: The button is no longer on the PC. Refresh the deck.
\"{name}\" está cheio. Libere uma casa e: "{name}" is full. Free up a slot and try again.
That slot already has a button.
Manda uma mensagem OSC, UDP ou TCP a par: Sends an OSC, UDP or TCP message from the PC: mixing consoles, QLab and other devices on the network.
Um por linha: i:1 (inteiro), f:0.5 (deci: One per line: i:1 (integer), f:0.5 (decimal), s:text, T or F. With no prefix, the type is inferred.
Corte, transição, entradas, overlays, áu: Cut, transition, inputs, overlays, audio, recording and streaming, with vMix state on the button.
Também aceita o número ou o nome da entr: Also accepts the number or name of the input.
Nome da função na referência de atalhos: Function name in the vMix shortcut reference.
Como na Web API do vMix, com os valores: As in the vMix Web API, with values in URL format.
Não foi possível conectar ao vMix. Confi: Couldn't connect to vMix. Check that it's open and the address is right.
Abra o vMix. A TCP API dele (porta 8099): Open vMix. Its TCP API (port 8099) is already on, with no setup or password.
vMix neste PC: toque em Conectar. Em out: vMix on this PC: tap Connect. On another PC: enter its IP and allow port 8099 in its firewall.
Depois, crie botões do tipo vMix. As ent: Then create vMix buttons. The inputs show up in the list.
Endereço do PC com o vMix: Address of the PC running vMix
Corte, entradas, overlays, gravação e ta: Cut, inputs, overlays, recording and tally
No ar, automação, players e cartwall do: On air, automation, players and cartwall in mAirList, through its REST interface.
Um comando da lista de comandos remotos: A command from the mAirList remote command list.
Usuário ou senha recusados pelo mAirList: mAirList refused the username or password.
Não foi possível falar com o mAirList. C: Couldn't reach mAirList. Check that it's open and the REST interface is on.
Ligue o plugin ExecuteCommand na interfa: Turn on the ExecuteCommand plugin in the mAirList REST interface.
No mAirList, abra Configuração → Remote: In mAirList, open Configuration → Remote Control and add a REST interface (the default port is 9300).
Crie um usuário e ligue os plugins Execu: Create a user and turn on the ExecuteCommand (commands) and GeneralRead (on-air state) plugins.
Preencha aqui o endereço, o usuário e a: Fill in the address, username and password here.
Licença: segundo o fórum do mAirList, a: License: according to the mAirList forum, the REST interface needs the Advanced edition or higher.
No ar, automação, players e cartwall: On air, automation, players and cartwall
Player, AutoDJ, modo assistido, entrada: Player, AutoDJ, assisted mode, live input and carts in RadioDJ, through the REST Server plugin.
Contando de cima, como na tela do RadioD: Counting from the top, as on the RadioDJ screen (1 = the first).
ID no banco do RadioDJ. Há relatos de er: ID in the RadioDJ database. Errors with these commands have been reported on version 2.0.4.
Um comando da lista nas opções do plugin: A command from the list in the REST Server plugin options.
O RadioDJ não entendeu o pedido. Confira: RadioDJ didn't understand the request. Check the REST Server plugin password.
Não foi possível falar com o RadioDJ. Co: Couldn't reach RadioDJ. Check that it's open and the REST Server plugin is on.
No RadioDJ 2, copie o Plugin_RestServer: In RadioDJ 2, copy Plugin_RestServer from the "Disabled Plugins" folder to the Plugins folder and open RadioDJ.
Nas opções do plugin, defina o endereço,: In the plugin options, set the address, port and password, and start the server.
Preencha aqui o mesmo endereço e a mesma: Fill in the same address and password here.
Player, AutoDJ, entrada ao vivo e carts: Player, AutoDJ, live input and carts
Tela cheia de tally ou ON AIR, ou o esta: Full-screen tally or ON AIR, or the state of a scene, input or microphone on the button.
Só mostrar o estado no botão: Only show the state on the button
A lista traz só o que está conectado ago: The list only shows what is connected now.
Sem resposta do PC ou do programa. O est: No response from the PC or the program. The state is unknown.
O celular em tela cheia como luz de no a: The phone in full screen as an on-air light
Abre a superfície do Bitfocus Companion:: Opens the Bitfocus Companion surface: the keys and pages set up there, in full screen.
Couldn't connect to Companion. Check that it's open and the address is right.
Endereço inválido. Use um IP ou nome, co: Invalid address. Use an IP or name, with the port if it is different.
O PC não está conectado ao Companion. Co: The PC isn't connected to Companion. Set it up in Integrations → Companion.
Abra o Companion. A porta da Satellite A: Open Companion. The Satellite API port (16622) is on by default.
Companion neste PC: toque em Conectar. E: Companion on this PC: tap Connect. On another PC: enter its IP.
O DroidDeck aparece em Surfaces no Compa: DroidDeck shows up under Surfaces in Companion, as a device with this grid.
Abra a superfície aqui ou crie um botão: Open the surface here or create a Companion button on the deck.
O celular como superfície do Bitfocus Co: The phone as a Bitfocus Companion surface
Tap the screen to turn it on or off.
